To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) WoW machinima production tools were developed in the context of a community of practice, and (2) the tools were designed to support specific aesthetic conventions, and (3) these aesthetic conventions were in turn influenced by the tools themselves.
machinima production tools are a vernacular history, a history that is created by the people who use them, of a creative medium.

machinima production tools are an example of vernacular computing, in that they are created by users, for users, to meet the needs of a community of users, in a way that reflects the aesthetic conventions of that community, and are then appropriated by the same community as a means to further develop the aesthetic conventions that they were created to support.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the ways that creativity support tools can be designed and used to support the emergence of new creative practices, and how these tools can be designed to support new creative practices as they arise.
understanding the creative practices of a large online community through the lens of its outputs and how those outputs shape the creative practices of the community.
the creative practices of expert amateurs, the creative tools they develop to support those practices, and how those tools are appropriated and extended over time.

machinima production in WoW has been a complex and evolving process, with a variety of different tools being used to create machinima, each with their own advantages and disadvantages.
the history of machinima in WoW is one of appropriation, in which a community's creative needs and the creative tools they use to meet these needs coevolve over time.
the history of the machinima production tools is a history of the machinema community itself.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

machinima production tools, and the creative practices that they support, are the result of a vernacular history, one that has been shaped and driven by the needs and requirements of the machinima community.

the machinima community has a rich history of creative practices and tools that have been built to support the creation of machinima, and this history is a rich source of insight into the community's aesthetic values and practices.

we are able to trace the emergence of a vernacular history through the lens of the creative practices and the tools that support them, and in doing so, we can see how the creative community and its tools coevolved.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the study of creative communities at scale requires an understanding not only of their outputs (e.g., machinima) and the tools that they create (e.g., video editing software), but also the emergent creative practices that are developed over time.
the history of machinima in WoW is one of a community's creative works, practices and tools co-evolving together.
